finding.finding: Only the authoritative snapshot establishes an operational fact. It reports grid power unavailable at Agalawatta (S05).

No resolved equipment or link faults are present, so the matching repair actions are not currently indicated. S01 has verified grid-power failure; the generator action is feasible with available G1 and crew skills, but its 60-minute availability and 10-minute deployment duration do not establish a lasting power repair. S05 grid power remains unknown. No unsafe or impossible action is evidenced, so no defer requests are warranted.
